current.text: He signed with the Pelicans as a restricted free agent this offseason.

He is not in the projected starting five. Zion Williamson, Trey Murphy, Dejounte Murray and likely Yves Missi start, and the last spot goes to Jeremiah Fears or Herb Jones. He was added to the bench of a crowded rotation.
He is projected to play about eight fewer minutes per game in New Orleans. He could take shots from Fears, Murphy, Murray and Zion.

durable.text: He drives well and gets to the rim and the free throw line. He does not defend, pass or shoot well.
His rebounding has improved. His defensive numbers are bad.
